posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
I'm considering the following model

[http://www.lasermate.com/GMLN.html](http://www.lasermate.com/GMLN.html)

which they claim is suitable for holography.

The CL is low-ish but good enough at 1+ meters but it's also listed as multimode. I've got an email in to them to get more information on just how multimode it is. After all the 315M is technically multimode (so I hear) but the other lines are so weak that they don't matter. I don't yet know if that's true for the GMLN-532 but at $1,625.00 it's worth looking into.

Does anyone have any experience with the company or their lasers?

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
When it rains, it pours. I didn't get any information from them for several days and now they've come back with:

> longitudinal mode space for 532nm green low noise laser is about 5Ghz.

so based on what I've read this probably won't work even though they list holography as something this model can be used for.

btw, their single-mode model is well out of my range right now at $7K+

posts.author: Tony
posts.content_md: Just remember, holograms have been made with sodium-vapor street lamps, so it's easy to claim a laser is usable for holography!!
